name: osquery
description: SQL-based operating system instrumentation framework for security monitoring and compliance

tools.description: Background daemon for continuous system monitoring and log collection using SQL queries
tools.usage:
osqueryd --config_path=osquery.conf # Run with config file
osqueryd --verbose # Enable verbose logging
osqueryd --database_path=osquery.db # Custom database location
osqueryd --disable_events # Disable event collection

tools.description: Interactive shell for ad-hoc system queries and investigation using SQL syntax
tools.usage:
osqueryi # Start interactive shell
osqueryi --json 'SELECT * FROM processes;' # JSON output
osqueryi --line 'SELECT name FROM processes;' # Line-based output
osqueryi --config_path=config.conf # Use config file
osqueryi '.tables' # List available tables
